directory.name: PostTrainLLM
directory.description: An experimental browser model playground: run small language models locally with visible generation metrics.
directory.makerNote: I use PostTrainLLM to explore local model training and turn those experiments into repeatable recipes for specialist models.

purposeContract.purpose: PostTrainLLM turns local model-training experiments into measured, reproducible recipes for useful specialist language models.
purposeContract.audience: Practitioners learning or running post-training workflows on personal Apple hardware and in the browser.
purposeContract.outcome: Train, evaluate, compare, and run specialist models with evidence about what worked and why.
purposeContract.mechanism: A local factory joins datasets, training methods, evaluation, experiment tracking, and inference into repeatable recipes.
purposeContract.proof: The project contains working browser and Mac-local experiments, evaluation infrastructure, and reproducible training paths.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore the measured recipes and follow new experiments as they produce reproducible proof rather than scale claims.

directory.name: Live
directory.description: A free personality and hobby quiz that suggests a small experiment to try; account planning is not yet qualified.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a product that helps people live more intentionally through goals, possibilities, and things worth anticipating.

purposeContract.purpose: Live helps a person turn passive wanting into a life they can deliberately imagine, plan, and experience.
purposeContract.audience: People who want meaningful goals, possibilities, and experiences to look forward to.
purposeContract.outcome: Build a personal catalogue of things worth doing and keep moving from possibility toward lived experience.
purposeContract.mechanism: The independent app combines a bucket list, goals, discovery, search, and suggestions around one private life catalogue.
purposeContract.proof: The product is independently owned, in active dogfooding, and retains its established data and authentication boundary.
purposeContract.nextAction: Open Live and use the catalogue, search, and suggestions to add or act on something you genuinely want to experience.

directory.name: SaaS Maker
directory.description: A public directory of working experiments, reference projects and reusable tooling.
directory.makerNote: I use SaaS Maker as the public home for Fleet and as a workshop for reusable feedback, workflow, and automation tools.

purposeContract.purpose: SaaS Maker is the public product studio and reusable tooling workshop for the Fleet portfolio.
purposeContract.audience: Visitors exploring Sarthak’s products and builders consuming the studio’s public packages, workflows, and evidence.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand the body of work and reuse the tools that have earned a stable place across its products.
purposeContract.mechanism: A generated public directory sits beside shared feedback, UI, workflow, skill, and automation tooling maintained through real Fleet use.
purposeContract.proof: It publishes the canonical privacy-safe project directory and houses packages and tooling used by multiple independent repositories.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore the complete directory or open the public tooling catalogue; product-specific work continues in each owning repository.

directory.name: GitStat
directory.description: An experimental public GitHub analysis tool for repository activity, contributions and code churn.
directory.makerNote: I built GitStat to understand how my time and code churn are distributed across a large collection of repositories.

purposeContract.purpose: GitStat explains how engineering effort, contribution history, and code churn are distributed across many repositories.
purposeContract.audience: A developer managing enough GitHub projects that the normal contribution graph no longer answers useful questions.
purposeContract.outcome: See where time and change are going and distinguish sustained work from noisy activity.
purposeContract.mechanism: A GitHub analytics dashboard aggregates commits, churn, collaboration, and AI-assisted work across the portfolio.
purposeContract.proof: The maintained dashboard answers the owner’s recurring repository-distribution questions and is considered functionally complete.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use the dashboard for a concrete portfolio question; request new analysis only when an unanswered recurring question appears.

directory.name: High Signal Podcasts
directory.description: Search evidenced podcast claims and follow links back to the original episode or publication.
directory.makerNote: I’m building High Signal Podcasts to extract useful insights, recommendations, and emerging technology signals from top podcasts without listening to every episode.

purposeContract.purpose: High Signal Podcasts indexes evidenced claims, recommendations, books, and tools mentioned by notable podcast guests.
purposeContract.audience: People who want useful ideas from important podcasts without listening to every episode end to end.
purposeContract.outcome: Find what a person actually said or recommended and trace it back to the source episode.
purposeContract.mechanism: A source-backed corpus extracts attributable claims and organizes them into people, topics, books, tools, and emerging signals.
purposeContract.proof: The public corpus is live with 11,624 published claims, 294 named references, and 1,190 episodes with evidence.
purposeContract.nextAction: Browse a recommendation or claim and follow its quote, speaker, episode, and source receipt.

directory.name: IssuePages
directory.description: Read public GitHub issues as focused articles; publishing requires repository-owner access.
directory.makerNote: I wanted publishing a public page to be as simple as opening a GitHub issue.

purposeContract.purpose: IssuePages turns a GitHub issue into a readable, searchable public page.
purposeContract.audience: A builder or writer who wants lightweight publishing while keeping GitHub as the editing workflow.
purposeContract.outcome: Publish and update a durable page without adopting a separate CMS.
purposeContract.mechanism: An owner-approved issue is rendered into a public page with edit, archive, search, and source-link behavior.
purposeContract.proof: The owner-only production pilot has proven the issue-to-page loop at issues.sarthakagrawal.dev.
purposeContract.nextAction: Read the current pages or inspect the pilot; public authoring remains gated on moderation and authenticated rendering.

directory.name: Research Papers
directory.description: Search academic papers and follow original sources; account-based research chat is not yet qualified.
directory.makerNote: I wanted one large, searchable research library where retrieval could help me understand what already exists in a market.

purposeContract.purpose: Research Papers is a structured, searchable library for discovering and interrogating academic and market research.
purposeContract.audience: The Fleet owner investigating a concrete product, technical, or market question.
purposeContract.outcome: Find relevant papers and retrieve grounded context from a large retained corpus.
purposeContract.mechanism: A curated research dataset is indexed for search and retrieval-assisted analysis with source structure intact.
purposeContract.proof: The corpus and discovery system are essentially complete and available when a real research question appears.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use the library for a named research question; maintain the corpus rather than expanding it speculatively.

directory.name: Materia
directory.description: An educational body-and-remedy reference with condition-specific research citations and explicit uncertainty.
directory.makerNote: I want to make anatomy explorable and connect body concerns to clear, evidence-based information about treatments and remedies.

purposeContract.purpose: Materia explores an anatomy-led, evidence-graded reference for understanding body concerns, treatments, and remedies.
purposeContract.audience: People seeking a clearer educational map from a body concern to bounded, source-backed information.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand relevant anatomy and compare remedy evidence without mistaking the product for medical diagnosis.
purposeContract.mechanism: An interactive body-system model links concerns to structured remedy pages with explicit evidence grades and safety limits.
purposeContract.proof: A technically ambitious reference exists, but sustained evidence quality, medical safety, and content maintenance are unresolved.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use the retained material as an educational experiment only; reopen publication work after defining a medical-safety and evidence standard.

directory.name: LoopTV
directory.description: An experimental lean-back queue of curated science and other videos.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a more controlled and curated way to watch YouTube, shaped like television rather than an endless feed.

purposeContract.purpose: LoopTV turns curated YouTube channels into a calmer, lean-back television experience.
purposeContract.audience: Viewers who want intentional channel selection without YouTube’s endless recommendation feed.
purposeContract.outcome: Start watching something suitable quickly while retaining control over the available catalogue.
purposeContract.mechanism: A TV-like random player uses curated channels, focused search, and resilient handling of unavailable videos.
purposeContract.proof: The maintained product is complete for its intended viewing loop and already handles common catalogue failures.
purposeContract.nextAction: Open a curated channel and watch; future changes are limited to catalogue health or a proven viewing need.

directory.name: Starboard
directory.description: Explore public GitHub repositories and related projects through a searchable discovery experiment.
directory.makerNote: GitHub Stars stopped working for me at scale, so I built a better personal interface for exploring what I had saved.

purposeContract.purpose: Starboard makes a large GitHub Stars collection useful for personal exploration and project-aware tool discovery.
purposeContract.audience: Developers whose saved repositories have outgrown GitHub’s default starred-items interface.
purposeContract.outcome: Rediscover relevant tools, understand why they were saved, and connect them to current project needs.
purposeContract.mechanism: Synchronization, search, tags, lists, semantic retrieval, and project-aware recommendations operate over the user’s saved repositories.
purposeContract.proof: Core sync, search, organization, and project-aware discovery are largely complete and under focused active improvement.
purposeContract.nextAction: Connect or explore a Stars collection and use a current project question to drive discovery; avoid unrelated alert or reporting scope.

directory.name: Recipe Index
directory.description: Search vegetarian recipes by protein and calories, with links to the original recipe publishers.
directory.makerNote: I wanted a practical collection of higher-protein recipes that works with ingredients people actually use in Indian kitchens.

purposeContract.purpose: Recipe Index collects practical higher-protein vegetarian foods and recipes built around ingredients used in Indian kitchens.
purposeContract.audience: Vegetarian cooks in India who want more protein without abandoning familiar ingredients and meals.
purposeContract.outcome: Find realistic food ideas and compare their nutrition when meal variety becomes useful.
purposeContract.mechanism: A searchable food directory organizes recipes and ingredient-level protein comparisons for an Indian cooking context.
purposeContract.proof: A public directory exists, but the result did not become compelling enough to justify active expansion.
purposeContract.nextAction: Browse the retained directory; new recipe work waits until cooking variety becomes a real owner need.

directory.name: Look Sideways
directory.description: Explore sourced career turning points with explicit survivorship and forecasting limits.
directory.makerNote: I wanted to study the real advantages behind success and replace unhelpful comparison with evidence-based understanding.

purposeContract.purpose: Look Sideways shows why visible success cannot be reduced to a simple formula or a fair comparison with your own path.
purposeContract.audience: Readers who turn another person’s visible outcome into a judgment about their own pace, ability, or worth.
purposeContract.outcome: Replace flattened comparison with a more humane, evidence-bounded understanding of conditions, sequence, perseverance, and luck.
purposeContract.mechanism: A guided research exhibit connects source-linked life events and early-breakthrough paths through what people brought, were handed, and were surrounded by.
purposeContract.proof: The publication contains thousands of documented early-breakthrough paths, visible methodology, and ongoing source-linked profile coverage.
purposeContract.nextAction: Complete the guided comparison-futility journey, then inspect the underlying profiles, sources, and coverage.

directory.name: Sarthak Agrawal
directory.description: Selected engineering case studies, technical writing and working project demonstrations.
directory.makerNote: I maintain a personal website because I need one durable, accurate public record of my work and professional identity.

purposeContract.purpose: Sarthak Agrawal’s personal site is the durable public record of his work, writing, résumé, and professional identity.
purposeContract.audience: People evaluating Sarthak as an AI infrastructure and product engineer, collaborator, or builder.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand what he works on, what he has built, and how to verify or contact him.
purposeContract.mechanism: A maintained portfolio connects current positioning to selected projects, writing, résumé evidence, and public profiles.
purposeContract.proof: The public site is complete and satisfactory as the canonical professional record; updates follow changes in the underlying work.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore the current work and résumé or use the listed contact paths; do not infer stale focus areas from older copy.

directory.name: Field Track
directory.description: A labelled synthetic field-team demo for exploring routes, visits and agent summaries; Android tracking is not qualified.
directory.makerNote: I started Field Track for my father: a lower-cost way for managers to locate employees carrying administrator-enrolled Android devices and review retained routes.

purposeContract.purpose: Field Track is an administrator-managed field-location system for continuously enrolled Android devices and freshness-aware route review.
purposeContract.audience: A small field team and its manager, initially the owner’s father’s business.
purposeContract.outcome: Let a manager find employees quickly and review retained routes while managed tracking remains visible on each Android device.
purposeContract.mechanism: An administrator-enrolled Android app captures points continuously, queues them through weak 4G, and sends them to a team-scoped dashboard where server policy controls retention.
purposeContract.proof: A clearly labeled synthetic-data dashboard and bounded MVP path exist; economics and physical Android testing remain unresolved.
purposeContract.nextAction: Review the synthetic demo as a held MVP; validate business economics and a real Android device before expanding or onboarding a team.
